issues.body: The new text says "every handler here authorizes through crate::authz". In the same module, `options_handler` explicitly documents that OPTIONS is not auth-gated and does not call the authorizer. This makes the public security-boundary documentation inaccurate, even though OPTIONS intentionally exposes only method metadata and does not probe resource existence.
issues.fix_hint: Narrow the claim to the resource read and mutation handlers (for example, GET/HEAD/PUT/POST/DELETE/PATCH), and explicitly preserve OPTIONS as the unauthenticated metadata/CORS-preflight exception.
issues.title: Module docs falsely claim every handler performs WAC authorization

verdict.summary: The marker reconciliation is largely consistent with the implementation and the cited PUT/V4 test exercises the real handler path. However, the new module-level security claim is materially overbroad: it says every LDP handler authorizes through WAC, while OPTIONS is explicitly and intentionally not auth-gated. Because this is an honesty-sensitive description of the authorization boundary, it should be corrected before approval.
